panels.speaker: person.ione
lines: Look at me. Follow the lamp.

panels.speaker: person.ione
lines: Your memory is not. It was taken.
Whole, like a net pulled from the water.

panels.speaker: person.ione
lines: It takes something and keeps it.

panels.speaker: person.ione
lines: Sometimes the rays give it back.
Nobody else can. I am sorry, Wrack.
